name: fuyao-pi
description: Fuyao's personal Pi agent: first-party plugins, pinned companions, and portable configuration

scripts.build:pi-worker:all: bun run build:pi-worker:arm64 && bun run build:pi-worker:x64
scripts.test:memory: FUYAO_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DISABLED=1 node --import tsx packages/memory/tests/self-test.test.ts && FUYAO_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_DISABLED=1 node --import tsx --test packages/memory/tests/hybrid.test.ts packages/memory/tests/auto-embed.test.ts packages/memory/tests/auto-lifecycle.test.ts packages/memory/tests/activity.test.ts packages/memory/tests/browser.test.ts packages/memory/tests/revisions.test.ts packages/memory/tests/compression-scan.test.ts packages/memory/tests/source-policy.test.ts packages/memory/tests/project-scope.test.ts packages/memory/tests/scope-lifecycle.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run check:ui && bun run test
